title: Operational Compliance
predicted_tip: Projected from planned absences + certificate expiry over the next 14 days
absences_help: Recorded leave/training/mission windows are projected over the next 14 days together with certificate expiries - a rule that would drop below its minimum shows a predicted date and alerts before it happens.
no_certs: No certifications recorded in your scope.
import_help: Load your existing certificate register in one pass. Preview first - it validates every row and reports what would happen without writing anything. Re-importing the same file is safe (duplicates are skipped).
roster_ph: Type to search - pick the numeric id
policy_help: Validity drives expiry (blank = never expires). Decay marks a skill level as lapsed / unverified when the last assessment is older than N months - reported below, never destructively rewritten.
no_lapsed: No lapsed skill levels - every decay-tracked skill is current.
prog_no_activity: No assessment activity recorded yet - the curve starts with the first campaign.
prog_meas_intro: Every round of measurement is its own dated record, attached to its campaign. Earlier measurements are never modified or erased.
prog_meas_none: No competency has been measured twice yet: progression appears from the second measurement onwards.
prog_meas_count: {{n}} competency(ies) measured more than once, out of {{rounds}} recorded measurement(s).
da_burndown_none: No open campaign - the burndown appears while a cycle is running.
da_team_prog: Team Progression - Avg Confirmed Level by Department
da_team_prog_none: No confirmed assessments in the window yet.
impact_help: Every row is a role requirement that is NO LONGER met purely because the held certificate expired or was revoked. These people no longer count as qualified on that skill in readiness, benchmark and the succession bench — until revalidation. The number of skills the role requires is unchanged: only the validity of the held ticket changed.
no_impact: No lapsed certificate is currently degrading a role requirement in your scope.
js_confirm_delete: Permanently delete the rule “{name}”? The deletion is audited and cannot be undone.
js_denied: Refused: that rule is outside your scope.
gen_breaches: of which {n} would be in BREACH immediately (alerting on creation)
gen_created: {n} rule(s) created, {b} of them already in breach
gen_confirm_breach: {n} of them will be in breach immediately and will raise an alert.
gen_preview_first: Preview first: the confirmation has to be about numbers you have seen.
gen_changed: The plan changed since the preview ({n} rule(s), {b} in breach). Nothing was created — check and confirm again.
gen_too_many: {n} rules exceed the cap of {cap} per generation. Narrow the pillar or the scope.
gen_none: Nothing to create: it all exists already, or no unit matches.
gen_cap_note: The preview also states how many rules would be in BREACH the moment they exist — a grid that is entirely in breach is an alert storm, not a compliance programme. Creation is capped per generation and alerting is batched beyond the threshold.
da_c_not_launched: campaign not launched in this department
err_rule_out_of_scope: This org unit is outside your scope.
reg_intro: This register is generated each time it is opened from the application's actual configuration: it describes what is switched on, what is kept, and who can see what. It is intended for the works council or employee representatives.
reg_print_hint: Choose "Save as PDF" in the browser's print dialogue.
reg_mod_core: Core: skills framework, self-assessments, reviews, gaps, operational compliance
reg_mod_v2: Development and talent modules: development plans, improvement plans, 9-box, coaching, lifecycle, continuity and risk of loss, learning
reg_licence_unmanaged: Unmanaged appliance: every feature is available
reg_ret_leaver: Personal data of a person who has left ({{country}})
reg_ret_pseudonymise: Pseudonymisation (the audit trail is never deleted)
reg_ret_no_country: No active country: no retention period configured
reg_sec_access: 3. Who can see the 9-box and risk scores
reg_acc_risk_viewers: Delegated administrators holding the risk-of-loss permission
reg_reach_disclosed: Only once their placement is disclosed to them
reg_risk_module_off: The continuity module is switched off: these scores cannot be viewed on any screen.
reg_copilot_off: No data is sent to a language model.
reg_copilot_note: Names, employee numbers and sites are replaced with random tokens before anything is sent, and every query is recorded in the audit trail.
reg_sso_off: SSO off: sign-in with username and password
reg_scim: Active API keys: {{active}}, of which {{write}} can write (required for SCIM provisioning)
reg_audit_immutable: Rows cannot be changed or deleted
reg_categories_intro: The list is the one used by a person's data export (right of access): no category processed is missing from it.
reg_footer: Automatically generated document. For any question, contact the data controller.
reg_aud_self_line_hr: You, your reporting line and HR in your scope
reg_aud_talent_conf: Your reporting line and HR holding the talent-review permission; you, once the placement is disclosed
reg_aud_risk_conf: Your reporting line and HR holding the risk-of-loss permission; never yourself
cat_profile: Record: name, employee number, contact details, role, placement
mydata_nav_title: The data recorded about you, who can see it, and how to request an export or erasure
mydata_intro: Here is every category of personal data the application keeps about you, with the number of records, who can consult it and how long it is kept.
mydata_withheld_title: The full content of this category is given to you on a formal access request.
mydata_retention_days: During your employment, then {{n}} days after you leave
mydata_retention_default: During your employment, then for the period set for your country
mydata_after: At the end of that period the data is pseudonymised: your name no longer appears. The audit trail, which holds only technical identifiers, is kept.
mydata_rights_body: You can obtain a full copy of your data (right of access and portability) or ask for it to be erased. Send your request to your HR department or to the data protection officer: an administrator produces the export or carries out the erasure, and every operation is recorded.
mydata_rights_limits: Some data may be kept where the law requires it (for example a legal hold).
mydata_failed: Your data could not be read just now. Please try again later; your right of access through HR is unaffected.
cat_oneOnOneNotes: One-to-one notes (shared, and your private notes)
upload_err_type_not_allowed: This file type is not accepted here.
upload_err_type_mismatch: The file content does not match its extension.
upload_err_malformed: The upload was incomplete or malformed. Please try again.
upload_err_zip_unsupported: This archive format is not supported (encrypted or ZIP64 archive).
upload_err_zip_entries: The file contains too many internal parts to be imported safely.
upload_err_zip_too_large: Once decompressed, the file exceeds the size that can be imported safely. Split it into smaller files.
evidence_not_scanned_warning: This file has not been virus-scanned. It is downloaded, never opened in the browser: open it with care.
evidence_not_scanned_restricted: This file has not been virus-scanned: only the person who uploaded it, the holder's reporting line and HR can download it.
evidence_not_clean: Evidence unavailable: the virus scan is pending, failed or detected a threat.
av_no_scanner_alert: No antivirus is scanning uploaded files (neither ClamAV nor Microsoft Defender). Evidence is accepted as "not scanned", with restricted access.
privacy_notice_required: Please read and acknowledge the privacy notice first.
privacy_notice_ack_intro: Please read this notice. Confirm below that you have read it to continue to the application.
privacy_notice_rights_hint: You can read it again at any time, download your data and object to profiling from the “What is recorded about me” page.
privacy_download_hint: The file holds every category above except the confidential talent categories, which are named in it.
privacy_objection_body: The application computes a retention-risk indicator, names the people who are the only holder of a skill and proposes development actions from the 9-box grid. You can object to this profiling: the indicator is then not computed for you, you are not named in these lists, and any automatic proposal waits for a human decision.
privacy_objection_unreadable: Your objection status could not be read. Please try again later.
privacy_objection_recorded: Your objection to profiling is recorded. HR has been told.
privacy_objection_already: Your objection to profiling was already recorded.
privacy_objection_withdrawn: Your objection to profiling is withdrawn.
privacy_published: Privacy notice version {{version}} is published. Everyone will be asked to acknowledge it.
privacy_reviewed: The objection is marked as reviewed.
privacy_err_failed: The request could not be completed.
privacy_err_rate_limited: You have reached the limit of {{n}} downloads per hour. Please try again later.
privacy_err_no_identity: This account cannot perform this action.
privacy_err_stale_version: A newer version of the notice was published meanwhile. Please read it.
privacy_err_employees_only: Only an employee account can do this.
privacy_err_notice_incomplete: Both titles and both texts (French and English) are required.
privacy_err_notice_placeholders: The notice still contains [[...]] placeholders. Fill them in before publishing.
privacy_err_notice_publish_conflict: Another version was being published at the same time. Please try again.
privacy_err_forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
privacy_err_not_found: This item no longer exists or is already closed.
privacy_err_bad_resolution: Choose to proceed or to dismiss.
privacy_err_already_resolved: This held action was already decided.
privacy_reg_notice_none: No notice is published yet: nobody is asked to acknowledge one.
privacy_reg_notice_edit: Edit and publish a new version
privacy_reg_notice_help: Plain text: a line starting with “## ” is a heading, “- ” a bullet, a blank line a new paragraph. Replace every [[...]] placeholder. Publishing creates a new version; everyone signed in is then asked to acknowledge it.
privacy_reg_objections_intro: People who objected are not scored for retention risk, are not named as sole holders or in the copilot's rankings, and their automatic development actions wait here for a decision.
